_comment: Southpaw OS vision settings (Member D). Any value left out falls back to the default in vision_config.py. Try a value once without editing: --set section.name=value

camera._comment: Webcam number (0 = /dev/video0), a /dev/v4l/by-id/... path, or a video file.

pose._comment: MediaPipe PoseLandmarker settings. min_visibility: ignore body points below this (hidden/off-screen).

player._comment: orthodox = left hand leads (left straight = jab). southpaw = the reverse.

tracker._comment: Distances in body lengths (torso length on screen). motion: '2d' (default, least noisy) or '2d+depth' (adds MediaPipe 3D depth; catches punches towards/away from the camera, but noisy depth causes false alarms).

punch_detector._comment: When a hand movement counts as a punch, and when it is over. See punch_detector.py for the logic.

classifier._comment: Rules on the peak pose. Elbow angle >= straight_min_elbow_deg = straight; else uppercut score (forearm up + elbow low + rise) >= uppercut_threshold = uppercut, else hook. Use evaluate.py's suggested values.

contact._comment: Bag zone outline from calibrate.py (calibration.local.json, git-ignored).

output._comment: Where vision events go (UDP JSON). Same Pi as the hub: 127.0.0.1. Vision on a laptop: the Pi's IP.

debug._comment: show_window needs a desktop (Raspberry Pi Connect). record_path: null = don't record.
